\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.9}
\newcommand{\textbox}[2]{\setbox0=\hbox{$#2$}\typeout{BOX #1: \the\wd0,\the\ht0,\the\dp0}}
\newcommand{\point}[2]{\pgfextractx{\dimen0}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}\pgfextracty{\dimen2}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}\typeout{POINT #1.#2: \the\dimen0,\the\dimen2}}
\begin{document}
\textbox{positive}{0.5}\textbox{negative}{-0.5}
\textbox{pi}{\pi}\textbox{fraction}{\frac{\pi}{2}}
\textbox{annotation}{x=y\approx0.739085}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[axis lines=middle,enlarge x limits=true,enlarge y limits=true,
 xmin=0,xmax=pi,ymin=-1,ymax=1,width=12cm,height=8cm,
 xtick={0,1.5708,3.14159},xticklabels={$0$,$\frac{\pi}{2}$,$\pi$},
 xlabel=$x$,ylabel=$y$,
 xticklabel style={name=xtick-\ticknum},yticklabel style={name=ytick-\ticknum,execute at begin node={\typeout{YTICK \ticknum: \tick}}},
 xlabel style={name=xlabel},ylabel style={name=ylabel}]
\addplot[domain=-8:8,very thick,samples=200,blue] {cos(deg(x))};
\coordinate (a) at (axis cs:0.739085,0.739085);
\node[label={[name=annotation,label distance=0.1cm]0:$x=y\approx0.739085$}] at (a) {};
\end{axis}
\point{current axis}{origin}\point{a}{center}
\foreach \n in {xtick-1,xtick-2,ytick-1,ytick-2,ytick-4,ytick-5,xlabel,ylabel,annotation}{
 \point{\n}{center}\point{\n}{text}\point{\n}{north east}\point{\n}{south west}}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
